name: mazz-mobile
description: Mazz Editor 移动端壳（Capacitor）：渲染层 + Web 桥，编译 Android/iOS

scripts.sync: npm run prepare && cap sync android

scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:win: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
